patthana21.28:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā hetu parittārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.28:2.1: na hetuṃ mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu mahaggatārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana21.28:3.1: na hetuṃ na appamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā hetu appamāṇārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā, hetuyā tīṇi. na hetuṃ na hīnaṃ
